content.text: If I remember correctly, there is a way to trigger email reset for the google workspace member and require them to change their own password via Oauth access token of an admin. How I can do that.

input.query: Admin SDK Directory API users.update changePasswordAtNextLogin reset password

content.text:
You're half right. The Admin SDK Directory API can force a password change at next sign-in. It has **no endpoint that sends Google's password-reset email**. That email option only exists in the Admin console (Users → Reset password → "Email password").

**Force a change at next login** with `users.patch` and the admin's access token:

```bash
curl -X PATCH \
  "https://admin.googleapis.com/admin/directory/v1/users/member@yourdomain.com" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"changePasswordAtNextLogin": true}'
```

To lock them out of the current password right away, set a temporary one in the same call:

```json
{ "password": "<random-temp-password>", "changePasswordAtNextLogin": true }
```

Then follow up:
- `POST /admin/directory/v1/users/{userKey}/signOut` ends their active sessions so the change takes effect now.
- Send them the temp password yourself (for example with the Gmail API, or to their `recoveryEmail` from `users.get`), because Google won't send it via the API.

**Requirements:**
- Scope: `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.user`
- The token must belong to a super admin, or to a delegated admin with the user-management privilege. A service account with domain-wide delegation impersonating such an admin also works.
- `changePasswordAtNextLogin` has no effect if the user signs in through a third-party IdP (SSO).

Source: [Directory API users resource](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/directory/reference/rest/v1/users) and [users.update](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/directory/reference/rest/v1/users/update).
